disclaimer: This is a rule reference, not legal advice. The building-permission clerk decides.
result_no_conflict: No setback conflict found against the checks listed
not_checked: Parking, staircase, ventilation shaft, courtyard, fire and structural rules were not checked
label_ground_coverage: Ground coverage (derived from setbacks, not a prescribed percentage)
msg_area_mismatch: Entered dimensions give {computed} sq m; stated plot area is {stated} sq m
msg_refuse_corner:
Corner plot: Rule 56(1)(a) sets the front open space by "the street facing the plot", so one reading takes the street the plot faces (its frontage street) and applies the Rule 56(1)(a) row for that street's width.

Rule 65(2) lets the wider street govern height, so a second reading takes the wider street to set the front open space as well. The Rules do not state which street sets the front open space; the clerk decides. No drawing is produced for plots abutting two streets.
msg_refuse_use: Plan check version 1 supports residential buildings only; see Rule 57 for other occupancies.
msg_refuse_height: Plan check version 1 supports buildings up to 12.5 m; Rule 42 Tables 4 and 5 govern above that.
exception_garage_side_rear: Garage at the rear end of the side open space
